AboutHero.label: Education // Course
AboutHero.title: The Rolling Scopes School
AboutHero.description: This project was developed as a final stage of the React JS course. RS School is a community-based non-profit education project that has been helping people start their careers in IT for over 10 years.

AboutProject.title: About This Project
AboutProject.description: AURA // EDITOR is a modern, high-performance OpenAPI specification tool designed for the next generation of web services. It provides a real-time validation environment, schema visualization, and interactive documentation, all wrapped in a sleek, minimalist interface inspired by futuristic tech aesthetics.

dastan.name: Dastan
dastan.description:
Architected the frontend application and led the implementation of the editor and Viewer core features, including OpenAPI validation, schema synchronization, JSON/YAML conversion, and the interactive Try-It-Out form.
Also set up the project's foundational infrastructure, including Next.js initialization, the UI Kit, auth form validation, and the responsive split-view layout for the Editor and Viewer.

meruert.name: Meruert
meruert.description:
Set up the core application architecture, including routing, i18n, API request proxying, and shared UI mechanisms. 
Implemented the Header and Footer, global loading and error states, as well as toast notifications, Spinner, and the project’s base pages.

anna.name: Anna
anna.description:
Implemented the About page, Supabase integration, and core authentication flows, including session management, protected routes, and user schema persistence.
Also configured CI/CD processes, including automated checks and preview deployments for project updates.
